nodes.label: Cracked Deepslate Bricks Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture showing deepslate bricks with visible crack lines running through them. Dark charcoal/slate-grey color with linear fractures overlaid on a brick grid pattern. Used to convey aged or damaged stonework in dungeon environments.
nodes.pattern: brick grid with overlaid crack fracture lines
nodes.game_purpose: aged/damaged deepslate brick block, dungeon aesthetic, structural decay indicator
